Qwen Code: which KYA replays were tested

Replays tested on Qwen Code

No replay has run on Qwen Code. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about Qwen Code.

What the Qwen Code setup page says about coverage

Qwen decides which tools go through MCP. KYA gates the ones that do. A tool Qwen executes outside MCP is outside the gate. Do not treat this setup as full coverage of the agent.

Source: the Qwen Code recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
